															BPSC 72nd CCE Pre Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

															Exam Pattern

															 

															Preliminary Exam:

															
																Type: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Number of Papers: 1
																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 2 hours
																Subjects: General Studies (current events, history, geography, polity, etc.)
																Negative Marking: Yes (usually 1/3 of the marks for each wrong answer)
															

															Mains Exam:

															
																Number of Papers: 4 (General Hindi, General Studies I, General Studies II, General Studies III)
																Total Marks: 1025 (General Hindi: 100, each General Studies paper: 250)
																Duration: Varies per paper (generally 3 hours)
																Interview: 120 marks
															

															Syllabus

															 

															Preliminary Exam Syllabus:

															General Studies:

															
																Current Events: National and international importance.
																History: Ancient, medieval, and modern history of India.
																Geography: Physical, economic, and human geography of India and the world.
																Polity: Indian Constitution, political system, governance, and public policy.
																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.
																Environment: Ecology, biodiversity, and environmental issues.
																General Science: Basic concepts of physics, chemistry, and biology.
															

															Mains Exam Syllabus:

															 

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.
															

															General Studies I:

															
																Indian History: Major events, freedom struggle, and cultural heritage.
																Geography: Physical geography, natural resources, and economic geography of India.
															

															General Studies II:

															
																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.
																International Relations: Relations with neighboring countries and major global issues.
															

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Stay updated with current affairs through newspapers and magazines.
																Refer to standard textbooks for in-depth understanding.
																Practice previous years' question papers and take mock tests.

															BPSC 72nd CCE Pre Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

															Exam Pattern

															 

															Preliminary Exam:

															
																Type: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Number of Papers: 1
																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 2 hours
																Subjects: General Studies (current events, history, geography, polity, etc.)
																Negative Marking: Yes (usually 1/3 of the marks for each wrong answer)
															

															Mains Exam:

															
																Number of Papers: 4 (General Hindi, General Studies I, General Studies II, General Studies III)
																Total Marks: 1025 (General Hindi: 100, each General Studies paper: 250)
																Duration: Varies per paper (generally 3 hours)
																Interview: 120 marks
															

															Syllabus

															 

															Preliminary Exam Syllabus:

															General Studies:

															
																Current Events: National and international importance.
																History: Ancient, medieval, and modern history of India.
																Geography: Physical, economic, and human geography of India and the world.
																Polity: Indian Constitution, political system, governance, and public policy.
																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.
																Environment: Ecology, biodiversity, and environmental issues.
																General Science: Basic concepts of physics, chemistry, and biology.
															

															Mains Exam Syllabus:

															 

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.
															

															General Studies I:

															
																Indian History: Major events, freedom struggle, and cultural heritage.
																Geography: Physical geography, natural resources, and economic geography of India.
															

															General Studies II:

															
																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.
																International Relations: Relations with neighboring countries and major global issues.
															

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Stay updated with current affairs through newspapers and magazines.
																Refer to standard textbooks for in-depth understanding.
																Practice previous years' question papers and take mock tests.

															Exam Pattern

															 

															Preliminary Exam:

															
																Type: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Number of Papers: 1
																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 2 hours
																Subjects: General Studies (current events, history, geography, polity, etc.)
																Negative Marking: Yes (usually 1/3 of the marks for each wrong answer)
															

															Mains Exam:

															
																Number of Papers: 4 (General Hindi, General Studies I, General Studies II, General Studies III)
																Total Marks: 1025 (General Hindi: 100, each General Studies paper: 250)
																Duration: Varies per paper (generally 3 hours)
																Interview: 120 marks
															

															Syllabus

															 

															Preliminary Exam Syllabus:

															General Studies:

															
																Current Events: National and international importance.
																History: Ancient, medieval, and modern history of India.
																Geography: Physical, economic, and human geography of India and the world.
																Polity: Indian Constitution, political system, governance, and public policy.
																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.
																Environment: Ecology, biodiversity, and environmental issues.
																General Science: Basic concepts of physics, chemistry, and biology.
															

															Mains Exam Syllabus:

															 

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.
															

															General Studies I:

															
																Indian History: Major events, freedom struggle, and cultural heritage.
																Geography: Physical geography, natural resources, and economic geography of India.
															

															General Studies II:

															
																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.
																International Relations: Relations with neighboring countries and major global issues.
															

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Stay updated with current affairs through newspapers and magazines.
																Refer to standard textbooks for in-depth understanding.
																Practice previous years' question papers and take mock tests.

															BPSC 72nd CCE Pre Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

															Exam Pattern

															 

															Preliminary Exam:

															
																Type: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Number of Papers: 1
																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 2 hours
																Subjects: General Studies (current events, history, geography, polity, etc.)
																Negative Marking: Yes (usually 1/3 of the marks for each wrong answer)
															

															Mains Exam:

															
																Number of Papers: 4 (General Hindi, General Studies I, General Studies II, General Studies III)
																Total Marks: 1025 (General Hindi: 100, each General Studies paper: 250)
																Duration: Varies per paper (generally 3 hours)
																Interview: 120 marks
															

															Syllabus

															 

															Preliminary Exam Syllabus:

															General Studies:

															
																Current Events: National and international importance.
																History: Ancient, medieval, and modern history of India.
																Geography: Physical, economic, and human geography of India and the world.
																Polity: Indian Constitution, political system, governance, and public policy.
																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.
																Environment: Ecology, biodiversity, and environmental issues.
																General Science: Basic concepts of physics, chemistry, and biology.
															

															Mains Exam Syllabus:

															 

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.
															

															General Studies I:

															
																Indian History: Major events, freedom struggle, and cultural heritage.
																Geography: Physical geography, natural resources, and economic geography of India.
															

															General Studies II:

															
																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.
																International Relations: Relations with neighboring countries and major global issues.
															

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Stay updated with current affairs through newspapers and magazines.
																Refer to standard textbooks for in-depth understanding.
																Practice previous years' question papers and take mock tests.

															Exam Pattern

															 

															Preliminary Exam:

															
																Type: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Number of Papers: 1
																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 2 hours
																Subjects: General Studies (current events, history, geography, polity, etc.)
																Negative Marking: Yes (usually 1/3 of the marks for each wrong answer)
															

															Mains Exam:

															
																Number of Papers: 4 (General Hindi, General Studies I, General Studies II, General Studies III)
																Total Marks: 1025 (General Hindi: 100, each General Studies paper: 250)
																Duration: Varies per paper (generally 3 hours)
																Interview: 120 marks
															

															Syllabus

															 

															Preliminary Exam Syllabus:

															General Studies:

															
																Current Events: National and international importance.
																History: Ancient, medieval, and modern history of India.
																Geography: Physical, economic, and human geography of India and the world.
																Polity: Indian Constitution, political system, governance, and public policy.
																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.
																Environment: Ecology, biodiversity, and environmental issues.
																General Science: Basic concepts of physics, chemistry, and biology.
															

															Mains Exam Syllabus:

															 

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.
															

															General Studies I:

															
																Indian History: Major events, freedom struggle, and cultural heritage.
																Geography: Physical geography, natural resources, and economic geography of India.
															

															General Studies II:

															
																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.
																International Relations: Relations with neighboring countries and major global issues.
															

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.

															BPSC 72nd CCE Pre Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

															Exam Pattern

															 

															Preliminary Exam:

															
																Type: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Number of Papers: 1
																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 2 hours
																Subjects: General Studies (current events, history, geography, polity, etc.)
																Negative Marking: Yes (usually 1/3 of the marks for each wrong answer)
															

															Mains Exam:

															
																Number of Papers: 4 (General Hindi, General Studies I, General Studies II, General Studies III)
																Total Marks: 1025 (General Hindi: 100, each General Studies paper: 250)
																Duration: Varies per paper (generally 3 hours)
																Interview: 120 marks
															

															Syllabus

															 

															Preliminary Exam Syllabus:

															General Studies:

															
																Current Events: National and international importance.
																History: Ancient, medieval, and modern history of India.
																Geography: Physical, economic, and human geography of India and the world.
																Polity: Indian Constitution, political system, governance, and public policy.
																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.
																Environment: Ecology, biodiversity, and environmental issues.
																General Science: Basic concepts of physics, chemistry, and biology.
															

															Mains Exam Syllabus:

															 

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.
															

															General Studies I:

															
																Indian History: Major events, freedom struggle, and cultural heritage.
																Geography: Physical geography, natural resources, and economic geography of India.
															

															General Studies II:

															
																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.
																International Relations: Relations with neighboring countries and major global issues.
															

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Stay updated with current affairs through newspapers and magazines.
																Refer to standard textbooks for in-depth understanding.
																Practice previous years' question papers and take mock tests. : Name of Post:

															BPSC 72nd CCE Pre Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

															Exam Pattern

															 

															Preliminary Exam:

															
																Type: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Number of Papers: 1
																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 2 hours
																Subjects: General Studies (current events, history, geography, polity, etc.)
																Negative Marking: Yes (usually 1/3 of the marks for each wrong answer)
															

															Mains Exam:

															
																Number of Papers: 4 (General Hindi, General Studies I, General Studies II, General Studies III)
																Total Marks: 1025 (General Hindi: 100, each General Studies paper: 250)
																Duration: Varies per paper (generally 3 hours)
																Interview: 120 marks
															

															Syllabus

															 

															Preliminary Exam Syllabus:

															General Studies:

															
																Current Events: National and international importance.
																History: Ancient, medieval, and modern history of India.
																Geography: Physical, economic, and human geography of India and the world.
																Polity: Indian Constitution, political system, governance, and public policy.
																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.
																Environment: Ecology, biodiversity, and environmental issues.
																General Science: Basic concepts of physics, chemistry, and biology.
															

															Mains Exam Syllabus:

															 

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.
															

															General Studies I:

															
																Indian History: Major events, freedom struggle, and cultural heritage.
																Geography: Physical geography, natural resources, and economic geography of India.
															

															General Studies II:

															
																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.
																International Relations: Relations with neighboring countries and major global issues.
															

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Stay updated with current affairs through newspapers and magazines.
																Refer to standard textbooks for in-depth understanding.
																Practice previous years' question papers and take mock tests.

															Exam Pattern

															 

															Preliminary Exam:

															
																Type: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Number of Papers: 1
																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 2 hours
																Subjects: General Studies (current events, history, geography, polity, etc.)
																Negative Marking: Yes (usually 1/3 of the marks for each wrong answer)
															

															Mains Exam:

															
																Number of Papers: 4 (General Hindi, General Studies I, General Studies II, General Studies III)

															Preliminary Exam Syllabus:

															General Studies:

															
																Current Events: National and international importance.

																Geography: Physical, economic, and human geography of India and the world.
																Polity: Indian Constitution, political system, governance, and public policy.
																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.
																Environment: Ecology, biodiversity, and environmental issues.
																General Science: Basic concepts of physics, chemistry, and biology.

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.
															

															General Studies I:

															
																Indian History: Major events, freedom struggle, and cultural heritage.
																Geography: Physical geography, natural resources, and economic geography of India.
															

															General Studies II:

															
																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.
																International Relations: Relations with neighboring countries and major global issues.
															

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Stay updated with current affairs through newspapers and magazines.
																Refer to standard textbooks for in-depth understanding.
																Practice previous years' question papers and take mock tests.

																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.

																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.

																Stay updated with current affairs through newspapers and magazines.
																Refer to standard textbooks for in-depth understanding.
																Practice previous years' question papers and take mock tests.

															BPSC 72nd CCE Pre Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

															Exam Pattern

															 

															Preliminary Exam:

															
																Type: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Number of Papers: 1
																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 2 hours
																Subjects: General Studies (current events, history, geography, polity, etc.)
																Negative Marking: Yes (usually 1/3 of the marks for each wrong answer)
															

															Mains Exam:

															
																Number of Papers: 4 (General Hindi, General Studies I, General Studies II, General Studies III)
																Total Marks: 1025 (General Hindi: 100, each General Studies paper: 250)
																Duration: Varies per paper (generally 3 hours)
																Interview: 120 marks
															

															Syllabus

															 

															Preliminary Exam Syllabus:

															General Studies:

															
																Current Events: National and international importance.
																History: Ancient, medieval, and modern history of India.
																Geography: Physical, economic, and human geography of India and the world.
																Polity: Indian Constitution, political system, governance, and public policy.
																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.
																Environment: Ecology, biodiversity, and environmental issues.
																General Science: Basic concepts of physics, chemistry, and biology.
															

															Mains Exam Syllabus:

															 

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.
															

															General Studies I:

															
																Indian History: Major events, freedom struggle, and cultural heritage.
																Geography: Physical geography, natural resources, and economic geography of India.
															

															General Studies II:

															
																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.
																International Relations: Relations with neighboring countries and major global issues.
															

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Stay updated with current affairs through newspapers and magazines.
																Refer to standard textbooks for in-depth understanding.
																Practice previous years' question papers and take mock tests.

															Preliminary Exam:

															
																Type: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)

																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 2 hours
																Subjects: General Studies (current events, history, geography, polity, etc.)

																Number of Papers: 4 (General Hindi, General Studies I, General Studies II, General Studies III)
																Total Marks: 1025 (General Hindi: 100, each General Studies paper: 250)

																Interview: 120 marks
															

															Syllabus

															 

															Preliminary Exam Syllabus:

															General Studies:

															
																Current Events: National and international importance.
																History: Ancient, medieval, and modern history of India.
																Geography: Physical, economic, and human geography of India and the world.
																Polity: Indian Constitution, political system, governance, and public policy.
																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.
																Environment: Ecology, biodiversity, and environmental issues.
																General Science: Basic concepts of physics, chemistry, and biology.
															

															Mains Exam Syllabus:

															 

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.
															

															General Studies I:

															
																Indian History: Major events, freedom struggle, and cultural heritage.
																Geography: Physical geography, natural resources, and economic geography of India.
															

															General Studies II:

															
																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.
																International Relations: Relations with neighboring countries and major global issues.
															

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Stay updated with current affairs through newspapers and magazines.
																Refer to standard textbooks for in-depth understanding.

															BPSC 72nd CCE Pre Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

															Exam Pattern

															 

															Preliminary Exam:

															
																Type: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Number of Papers: 1
																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 2 hours
																Subjects: General Studies (current events, history, geography, polity, etc.)
																Negative Marking: Yes (usually 1/3 of the marks for each wrong answer)
															

															Mains Exam:

															
																Number of Papers: 4 (General Hindi, General Studies I, General Studies II, General Studies III)
																Total Marks: 1025 (General Hindi: 100, each General Studies paper: 250)
																Duration: Varies per paper (generally 3 hours)
																Interview: 120 marks
															

															Syllabus

															 

															Preliminary Exam Syllabus:

															General Studies:

															
																Current Events: National and international importance.
																History: Ancient, medieval, and modern history of India.
																Geography: Physical, economic, and human geography of India and the world.
																Polity: Indian Constitution, political system, governance, and public policy.
																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.
																Environment: Ecology, biodiversity, and environmental issues.
																General Science: Basic concepts of physics, chemistry, and biology.
															

															Mains Exam Syllabus:

															 

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.
															

															General Studies I:

															
																Indian History: Major events, freedom struggle, and cultural heritage.
																Geography: Physical geography, natural resources, and economic geography of India.
															

															General Studies II:

															
																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.
																International Relations: Relations with neighboring countries and major global issues.
															

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Stay updated with current affairs through newspapers and magazines.
																Refer to standard textbooks for in-depth understanding.

															BPSC 72nd CCE Pre Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

															Exam Pattern

															 

															Preliminary Exam:

															
																Type: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)
																Number of Papers: 1
																Total Marks: 150
																Duration: 2 hours
																Subjects: General Studies (current events, history, geography, polity, etc.)
																Negative Marking: Yes (usually 1/3 of the marks for each wrong answer)
															

															Mains Exam:

															
																Number of Papers: 4 (General Hindi, General Studies I, General Studies II, General Studies III)
																Total Marks: 1025 (General Hindi: 100, each General Studies paper: 250)
																Duration: Varies per paper (generally 3 hours)
																Interview: 120 marks
															

															Syllabus

															 

															Preliminary Exam Syllabus:

															General Studies:

															
																Current Events: National and international importance.
																History: Ancient, medieval, and modern history of India.
																Geography: Physical, economic, and human geography of India and the world.
																Polity: Indian Constitution, political system, governance, and public policy.
																Economy: Basic concepts of economy, economic planning, and major government schemes.
																Environment: Ecology, biodiversity, and environmental issues.
																General Science: Basic concepts of physics, chemistry, and biology.
															

															Mains Exam Syllabus:

															 

															General Hindi:

															
																Comprehension, grammar, essay writing, and general language proficiency.
															

															General Studies I:

															
																Indian History: Major events, freedom struggle, and cultural heritage.
																Geography: Physical geography, natural resources, and economic geography of India.
															

															General Studies II:

															
																Polity and Governance: Constitution, rights issues, public administration, and governance.
																International Relations: Relations with neighboring countries and major global issues.
															

															General Studies III:

															
																Economy: Economic development, poverty, and planning.
																Science and Technology: Developments in science and technology and their impact on society.
																Environment: Environmental conservation and biodiversity.
															

															Preparation Tips:

															
																Stay updated with current affairs through newspapers and magazines.
																Refer to standard textbooks for in-depth understanding.
																Practice previous years' question papers and take mock tests.
